ja: Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人3 孫悟空がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
• ドラゴンボールZのラストで魔人ブウとの壮絶なバトルを繰り広げた超サイヤ人3孫悟空がFigure-rise Standardに登場！
• 特徴的な大ボリュームの髪型、険しく迫力に満ちたフェイスを完全再現！
• パーツを重ねあわせる構造で、瞳の細かな色分けまでも成形パーツで再現。ハイクオリティな完成度を実現！
• かめはめ波のエフェクトパーツや瞬間移動の手パーツが付属し、原作のさまざまなシーンを演出可能！
• 同時発売のFigure-rise Standard魔人ブウ（純粋）と組み合わせて、感動のラストバトルを再現可能！
• Figure-rise Standard「ドラゴンボール」シリーズを集めて、圧倒的バトルシーンを再現しよう！
en: Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan 3 Son Goku is now available with a renewed package! !
• Super Saiyan 3 Goku, who fought the fierce battle with Majin Buu at the end of Dragon Ball Z, is now available in Figure-rise Standard!
• The characteristic large volume hairstyle and rugged and powerful face are completely reproduced!
• With a structure in which parts are overlapped, even the detailed color coding of the eyes is reproduced with molded parts. Achieving high quality perfection!
• Comes with Kamehameha effect parts and teleportation hand parts, allowing you to create various scenes from the original!
• In combination with the simultaneously released Figure-rise Standard Majin Buu (pure), you can recreate the thrilling final battle!
• Collect Figure-rise Standard "Dragon Ball" series and recreate overwhelming battle scenes!
